instruction_en: Walk straight down the hallway, keeping the green decorative panel on your right. As you approach the end of the hallway, with a round, brown wall decoration on your left, turn left to enter the doorway. Walk into the bathroom and stop in front of the shower enclosure, with the toilet and sink on your left and the window directly ahead of you.
